# EGFootball5 (Kickoff) Platform
> Egypt Premier 5-a-Side Football Pitch Booking, Match Lobby & Stadium Management Infrastructure.
> Official Web Platform: https://egfootball5.web.app
> Operating Entity: EGFootball Sports Tech LLC (CR: 194820, Tax ID: 712-492-301, Obour City, Egypt)

## System Overview & Mission
EGFootball5 is an enterprise sports technology platform that automates 5-a-side and 7-a-side football turf reservations, match coordination, player lobbies, and stadium schedule locks across Cairo, Obour City, and nationwide Egyptian sports venues.

## Core Architectural Capabilities
- **Real-Time 15-Minute Slot Locks**: Prevents double-booking via atomic Firestore transactions (`/databases/{db}/documents/day_schedules`).
- **Match Lobbies & Squad Coordination**: Interactive 5-a-side tactical board, WhatsApp squad invites, and public player matching (GK, DEF, MID, STR).
- **Egyptian Payment Gateways**: Verifiable manual deposit proofs for Vodafone Cash and InstaPay with client-generated idempotency keys.
- **Pitch Pass & Subscriptions**: Tiered passes (Pro Pass & Pitch Pass VIP) in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) with booking discounts and extended reservation locks.
- **Multilingual & High Accessibility**: Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) with WCAG AAA high-contrast dark mode and zero layout shift.
- **Compliance & Privacy Shield**: Compliant with Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 151 of 2020), Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 181 of 2018), and GDPR Article 17 self-serve data erasure.

## Key APIs & Data Schemas
- `POST /api/admin/role`: Super-admin privilege management with IP and UID rate limiting.
- `POST /api/ai/chat`: Secure server-side AI sports advisory proxy with payload sanitization.
- `POST /api/ai/tts`: AI speech synthesis endpoint with origin validation.
- `GET /api/health`: Platform health diagnostics and connectivity verification.
